title: Developing intelligent control of photoresponsive materials: from switch-type to multi-mode
content:
Chem. Soc. Rev., 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D4CS00296B, Tutorial Review
Gaolu Zhu, Fanxi Sun, Yinghao Ji, Hongtao Hu, Mengyao Yang, Yichen Zhang, Xu Deng, Yonghao Zheng, Chen Wei, Dongsheng Wang
This tutorial review presents an overview of the developments of photoresponsive materials from switch-type to multi-mode control logic, which is discussed from two aspects: multi-stable control and multi-stage control.
